summary: Creates a shareable HTTPAgent object with the defined *options*, and returns a `4D.HTTPAgent` object
description:
The 4D.HTTPAgent.new() function creates a shareable HTTPAgent object with the defined options, and returns a 4D.HTTPAgent object.

The returned HTTPAgent object is used to customize connections to HTTP servers.

versionBehaviorChanges.change: Support of storeCertificateName property on macOS
Support of storeCertificateName property on Windows
